summaryZh: Pekkurnaz 实验室研究神经系统代谢稳态的分子原理。团队关注不同细胞类型中神经元代谢与线粒体功能的相互作用，包括线粒体运输和神经递质合成，以理解细胞生物能量调节及神经疾病中的代谢损伤；具体方法未明确。
researchQuestions: 哪些机制调节细胞生物能量学？
导致神经系统疾病的代谢障碍，其根本原因是什么？

evidence.quote: Our research focuses on the molecular principles of metabolic homeostasis in the nervous system.

By studying the interplay between neuronal metabolism and mitochondrial functions (from trafficking to neurotransmitter synthesis) across cell types, we aim to reveal fundamental insights into the mechanisms that regulate cellular bioenergetics and pinpoint the underlying causes of metabolic impairments which lead to neurological diseases.
